items.title: iPad Layout (Beta)
items.subtitle: On iPad, a sidebar and the feed sit beside the post you're reading. Turn it on in Interface.

items.title: Setup Assistant
items.subtitle: Pick Classic, Balanced or Full Featured and an appearance. Reopen it any time from Settings.

items.title: Pick Up Where You Left Off
items.subtitle: If iOS closes Apollo in the background, your feed, post and reading spot come back.

items.title: Faster Gallery View
items.subtitle: Pinch to resize the grid, down to four columns. Gallery View now works in Saved too.
